content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: a visible validation error appears on the cap / floor screen when the Counterparty field receives focus (event 277:a297 and earlier 63:a63), and it is still present after each Save click, which is followed by a save overlay and then a visible error (app:39, app:46, app:53), so the Save validation seems to fail on the same input each time.", "fix": "Fix: On the cap / floor screen, make the Save button run the Counterparty and Notional checks before submitting, and show the failing field's message inline beside that field (clearing it when the field is edited) instead of a generic visible error that appears after the save overlay closes.", "cited_event_ids": ["63:a63", "277:a297", "309", "310:w332", "314:x341", "app:39", "358", "app:46", "403", "app:53"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["The text and target field of the validation error are not in the events, so the Counterparty link is inferred from timing only.", "Whether editing Counterparty or Notional clears the error is not shown by the events.", "The save request/response and server-side validation rules are not in the data.", "The purpose of the OK click (15197, 15199) on a span is not confirmed.", "Whether the Save overlay is a spinner or a modal is not stated."]}
